item.title: State Senate Passes Cellphone Ban in High School Bill Unanimously - 92.1 WLHR
item.description: Cellphones will be banned in Georgia public high schools starting in the 2027-28 school year, if Gov. Brian Kemp signs House Bill 1009 into law. The state Senate passed the measure unanimously on Monday. Rep. Scott Hilton, R-Peachtree Corners, the author of the bill, called it a great, great, win for students and classrooms. item.title: CORRECTION: Northeast Georgia Animal Shelter is NOT CLOSED - NO PARVO - 92.1 WLHR
item.description: WLHR News reported this morning that the Northeast Georgia Animal Shelter is closed to the public for the next two weeks due to another outbreak of the parvovirus.
